paragraphs.source_en: Before the storm broke, an unexpected visitor arrived at Agui Castle, instantly throwing the entire castle into commotion and confusion. The visitor had brought only a dozen or so mounted attendants. At the main gate, he gave no name, saying merely that he wished to see Takenouchi Kyuroku.

paragraphs.source_en: Although Nobunaga had not ordered the Hisamatsu family into battle, Odaka Castle lay close at hand, the route between Agui and Kiyosu had been severed, and the enemy might attack at any moment; Kyuroku therefore stood guard atop the gate tower in full armor.
